title: Issuer's lien.
bodyText: A lien in favor of an issuer upon a certificated security is valid against a purchaser only if the right of the issuer to the lien is noted conspicuously on the security certificate.
bodyHtml: §490:8-209  Issuer's lien.  A lien in favor of an issuer upon a certificated security is valid against a purchaser only if the right of the issuer to the lien is noted conspicuously on the security certificate. [L 1997, c 33, pt of §2]
